summary: Conviction under Sections 302 and 149 IPC challenged; CCTV evidence non-compliant with Section 65B Evidence Act; absence of Test Identification Parade; motive based on uncorroborated testimony; Suraj witness not examined by prosecution; High Court affirmed conviction on testimonial evidence of PW-9; no proof of common object for Section 149 liability; conviction set aside for insufficient evidence.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; convictions set aside; appellants acquitted.
